title: On Unix, a relative store home starting with "file:" makes SQLite open a different file than Engram's own file operations use
outcome: On Unix, a relative store home starting with "file:" makes SQLite open a different file than Engram's own file operations use
acceptance: On Unix, opening a store whose SQLite filename would start with "file:" either opens exactly the literal path Engram's other file operations use, or is refused before any file is created, with a test showing which.
The open lock's special case for "file:" filenames is removed once sqlite_filename never yields one.
